_doc: Corpan City starter item catalog. Each row is an Item (see src/items/itemTypes.ts): id, name, art (placeholder:* cutout id resolved by cutoutArt), kind (cosmetic|consumable|quest|trade-good), slot? (cosmetics), rarity (common|rare|epic|seasonal), value (coins; 0 = priceless/untradeable), description, tags[]. Theme: Antigua-Guatemala circa 1770 colonial market town. Everything wholesome + kid-safe. `art` ids reuse cutoutArt's prop/cos vocabulary where possible; unknown ids fall back to the generic stall cutout until real atlases land. Cosmetics align with content/cosmetics/starter.json slots (top, hat, accessory, etc).

items.name: Ferry Token
items.description: A worn brass token. The boatman at the docks won't cross to Guadalajara without one.

items.name: City Gate Pass
items.description: A stamped pass that lets you through the old stone gate at dawn.

items.name: Sealed Letter
items.description: A letter sealed with red wax, addressed to someone across the plaza.

items.name: Market List
items.description: A grocer's handwritten list. Find each thing before the bell rings.

items.name: Lost Spectacles
items.description: A pair of round spectacles someone dropped. They can't read the sign without them.

items.name: Cathedral Key
items.description: A heavy iron key to the cathedral's side door. Only the bell-ringer knows the way.

items.name: Song Fragment
items.description: Half a verse of an old plaza song. Someone in the music quarter knows the rest.

items.name: Merchant's Ledger
items.description: A trader's book of accounts. The numbers don't add up.

items.name: Cinnamon Sticks
items.description: Fragrant bark from the highlands. The baker pays well for it.

items.name: Cacao Beans
items.description: Bitter beans worth their weight here. Prized by the chocolatier.

items.name: Vanilla Pods
items.description: Dark, sweet-smelling pods. Rare enough to barter for almost anything.

items.name: Woven Cloth
items.description: A bright bolt of handwoven cloth from the weavers' lane.

items.name: Clay Pot
items.description: A sturdy little pot, good for carrying water or beans.

items.name: Old Silver Real
items.description: A tarnished old coin from a faraway mint. Collectors will trade dearly for it.

items.name: Jade Bead
items.description: A smooth green bead, old as the hills. A small fortune in the right hands.

items.name: Beeswax Candle
items.description: A honey-scented candle. Lights the way after the lamps go out.

items.name: Pouch of Salt
items.description: Plain salt, but it keeps and everyone needs it.

items.name: Sack of Coffee
items.description: Green coffee from the slopes above town. The café owner's eyes light up.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: A warm roll from the baker. Restores a little pep for the road.

items.name: Cup of Coffee
items.description: Strong and sweet. A quick boost before the next challenge.

items.name: Basket of Fruit
items.description: Mangoes and bananas piled high. Shareable and sweet.

items.name: Water Skin
items.description: A full skin of cool water for the long walk between towns.

items.name: Map Scrap
items.description: A torn corner of a map. Read it to reveal a hidden corner of the district.

items.name: Lucky Charm
items.description: A little woven charm. Carry it for luck on your next challenge.

items.name: Herbal Tea
items.description: Calming mountain herbs in hot water. Steadies the nerves.

items.name: Straw Hat
items.description: A wide woven hat to keep the plaza sun off. Classic market style.

items.name: Tricorn Hat
items.description: A three-cornered felt hat. Very fashionable for a traveler of standing.

items.name: Lace Bonnet
items.description: A delicate lace bonnet, soft as morning mist.

items.name: Feathered Cap
items.description: A velvet cap with a single bright quetzal feather. Heads turn.

items.name: Linen Shirt
items.description: A breezy off-white linen shirt for warm market days.

items.name: Embroidered Blouse
items.description: Bright flowers stitched by the weavers of the lane.

items.name: Traveler's Coat
items.description: A long wool coat that's seen many roads. Warm and grand.

items.name: Leather Shoes
items.description: Sturdy buckled shoes for cobblestone streets.

items.name: Courier Satchel
items.description: A worn leather bag for letters and small treasures.

items.name: Woolen Shawl
items.description: A handwoven shawl in market colors, warm against the evening.

items.name: Quill Pen
items.description: A goose-feather quill, tucked behind the ear. The mark of a letter-writer.

items.name: Round Spectacles
items.description: Round wire spectacles. Scholarly and a touch dashing.

items.name: Festival Glow
items.description: A soft shimmer of festival lanterns that follows you through the plaza.

items.name: Marigold Petals
items.description: Bright marigold petals drift around you, just for the season.
